title: Lake Daddy Pontoons
specs: Dogs are welcome and family friendly
Parents/Guardians must bring their own US Coastguard-approved life jacket for children age 13 and under
Children must be accompanied by a parent/guardian
Pontoon fits up to 13 guests plus captain (14 total)
includes: Liquid Oasis mat, foam water saddle, football and sound system
Weighted faux blankets for the sunset rides
Water (Ice Mountain), 1 XL large cooler and ice
Access to any lake or restaurant in the area, limited to Tenney locks schedule
gap: Price amounts for rentals not stated
blurb: Guests board a pontoon boat with a captain for a lake cruise. Boats fit up to 13 guests plus captain. Flexible start times and durations from 2 to 8 hours are available. Dogs are welcome and family friendly.
extraNote: Boat cannot be rented without the captain · No glass of any kind is allowed aboard · No pulling or towing people or objects behind the boat · All participants must sign a waiver before boarding · No security deposit required · Multiple pickup spots: Marshall Park - Boat Ramp, Governor Nelson - Boat Launch, Spring Harbor Park - Boat Ramp, Tenney Park - Boat Ramp, Warner Park - Boat Ramp, Edgewater - Pier
